brief_summary: This trial is conducted in the United States of America (USA). The aim of this trial is to compare desired (target) with actual target amounts of insulin dispensed using NovoLog® Mix 70/30 FlexPen® and vial and syringe in subjects with type 2 diabetes mellitus. No insulin is administered in this trial - insulin is dispensed into an empty vial.
brief_title: Reliability of Dosing With NovoLog® Mix 70/30 FlexPen® Compared With Vial and Syringe

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Type 2 diabetes
* Insulin naive
* No previous experience administering injections

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any condition that, in the Investigator and/or Sponsor's opinion, could interfere with the results of this trial

official_title: Comparison of the Accuracy and Precision of NovoLog® Mix 70/30 FlexPen® to Vial and Syringe in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus

primary_outcomes.measure: Combined measure of accuracy and precision between target and measured amounts of insulin dispensed (mean square percent difference)
